lex.definition:
n. Law; as, lex talionis, the law of retaliation; lex terrae, the
   law of the land; lex fori, the law of the forum or court; lex loci, the
   law of the place; lex mercatoria, the law or custom of merchants.
lex.translation: [法] 法, 法律, 法律实体

lex angliae.translation: [法] 英格兰法, 普通法

lex fori.translation: [法] 审判地法, 法院地法

lex mercatoria.translation: [法] 商法, 商事法, 习惯商法

lex non scripta.translation: [法] 不成文法, 习惯法, 普通法

lexan.translation: n. 莱克桑(聚碳酸酯的商标名)

lexeme.definition: n a minimal unit (as a word or stem) in the lexicon of a language; `go' and `went' and `gone' and `going' are all members of the English lexeme `go'

lexemes.definition:
plural of lexeme
n a minimal unit (as a word or stem) in the lexicon of a language; `go' and `went' and `gone' and `going' are all members of the English lexeme `go'
lexemes.translation: (lexeme 的复数) n.[语]词位,词的单位

lexemic.translation:
a. [语]词位的,词汇单位的
n. [～s]词位学

lexer's operation.translation: [医] 累克塞氏手术(半月神经节切除术)

lexer's vessels.translation: [医] 累克塞氏血管, 近骺血管

lexias.translation: (lexia 的复数) 苛性液葡萄干

lexical.definition:
a. of or relating to words
a. of or relating to dictionaries
lexical.translation: a. 字典的, 词汇的

lexical database.translation: [网络] 词汇资料库；词汇数据库

lexicalise.definition: v make or coin into a word or accept a new word into the lexicon of a language

lexicality.translation: [计] 词汇编集, 编词典

lexicalization.definition: n. the process of making a word to express a concept

lexicalize.definition: v. make or coin into a word or accept a new word into the lexicon of a language

lexicalized.definition:
v make or coin into a word or accept a new word into the lexicon of a language
a expressed by a word
lexicalized.translation: vt. 编入词汇；使词汇化

lexicographer.definition: n. a compiler or writer of a dictionary; a student of the lexical component of language

lexicographers.definition:
plural of lexicographer
n. a compiler or writer of a dictionary; a student of the lexical component of language
lexicographers.translation: (lexicographer 的复数) n. 辞典编纂者

lexicographic.definition: a. of or relating to lexicography
lexicographic.translation: [计] 词典的, 词典编辑的

lexicographical.definition: a of or relating to lexicography

lexicographist.translation: n. 辞典编纂者, 辞典编辑人

lexicography.definition: n. the act of writing dictionaries

lexicology.definition: n. the branch of linguistics that studies the lexical component of language

lexicon.definition:
n a language user's knowledge of words
n a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
lexicon.translation:
n. 词汇, 词典, 辞典
[计] 辞典

lexiconize.translation: v. 编辑的辞典, 将...编入辞典

lexicons.definition:
n. a language user's knowledge of words
n. a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
lexicons.translation: n. 词典( lexicon的复数形式 ); 专门词汇

lexicostatistic.definition: a pertaining to statistical methods used in studying the relations between languages

lexicostatistics.definition: n. a statistical technique used in glottochronology; used to estimate how long ago different languages evolved from a common source language

lexie.translation: 莱克西, 莱克茜（女名）

lexigram.translation: n. 图形字,符号字(以图形或符号表示意义的字)

lexigrams.translation: (lexigram 的复数) n.图形字,符号字(以图形或符号表示意义的字)

lexigraphic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to lexigraphy.

lexigraphy.definition:
n. The art or practice of defining words; definition of
   words.
lexigraphy.translation: n. [语]词素文字(如汉字,一个字代表一个词)

lexington.definition:
n. town in eastern Massachusetts near Boston where the first battle of the American Revolution was fought
n. a city in eastern Kentucky; noted for raising thoroughbred horses
n. the first battle of the American Revolution (April 19, 1775)
lexington.translation: n. 列克星敦市（位于美国肯塔基州）

lexington and concord.translation: [网络] 莱克星顿与康科德战役；莱可星顿和康科德；辛顿与康科特战役

lexington-fayette.translation: [地名] [美国] 列克星敦费耶特

lexis.definition: n. all of the words in a language; all word forms having meaning or grammatical function

lexloci.translation: <拉>[律]地方法律(通常指合同缔结地的法律)

lexus.translation: n. 雷克萨斯（凌志）, 日本丰田汽车公司旗下豪华车品牌。
